user.title: Connect to NonRAID
user.description: Enter your nonraid-webui host and an API token. Mint a token from the nonraid-webui UI (Settings → Security → API tokens) or with `nonraid-tool login`.

data_description.host: Include the scheme (http:// or https://) and, if not the default port, the port number.
data_description.read_only: Check this if the token was minted with `nonraid-tool login --read-only` or the read-only option in the UI. Container start/stop switches are only created for a full-access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate NonRAID
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token for {host} no longer works. Mint a new one and enter it below.

error.invalid_host: Enter a full URL, including http:// or https://.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check that it hasn't been revoked and was pasted in full.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach that host. Check the URL and that nonraid-webui is running.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This NonRAID host is already configured.
